title: The recording script asks an image it never built for agent versions, so a fresh host skips the cleanup and exits 125
foundBy: session agent, re-recording opencode-fireworks with `./scripts/record-fixtures.sh opencode-fireworks` on a host that held no image for the new sandbox pin
details:
`scripts/record-fixtures.sh` resolves `$image` before `make` runs, from `cs-sandbox version --images`, as the published `ghcr.io/codesweep-ai/sandbox-slim:<version>`. On a host that holds no image for that version and no registry has one, `setup-smoke` builds it under the local name `localhost/codesweep-ai/sandbox-slim:<version>`. After the recording, the script runs `podman run --pull=never` on the published name to read the agent versions, and podman answers `image not known`.

The recording itself is kept, because the test has already passed and written the cassette. The script exits 125, though, and its cleanup never runs. That cleanup drops a cassette whose agent version the image no longer carries, so a stale cassette stays in the tree.

The script should ask for the image after `make`, the way `scripts/sandbox-image.sh` resolves it, which prefers the local name when only that one exists.
